blurb: Guests enjoy customized boat cruises on a 27-foot Sea Ray Sundancer cabin cruiser at a relaxed pace of 8-10 mph. Cruises include sightseeing, swimming, and stops at scenic or restaurant locations on Lake Minnetonka. The captain provides a Spotify Premium playlist, towels, cooler with ice, and safety equipment.
extraNote: All bookings require 50% deposit to confirm · $750 damage deposit held but not charged unless needed for repairs · Cancellation refund: 7+ days before 100%, 6 days 80%, 5 days 60%, 4 days 40%, 3 days 20%, 2 days or fewer no refund · No same-day bookings; book at least 24 hours in advance · If weather cancels, reschedule or full refund (less 3% fees) · No-shows or cancellations not related to weather are not refundable · Boat slip at Lord Fletchers Apartments, 4400 West Arm Road, Spring Park, MN 55384
